summary: Tested the 'Gallery Everywhere' feature end-to-end (frontend + API-via-network). All 8 products verified: every product exposes a colours array (3 colours, SculptFlex 4) with 4 studio images each; all 132 catalog/studio image URLs return HTTP 200 with image content-type (0 broken). Playwright verified all 8 product pages: default colour = colours[0], 4 desktop thumbnails (SculptFlex 7 = 3 videos + 4 photos), every colour swatch (data-testid colour-{kebab}) swaps the main gallery image and updates selected-colour-name, and selected size M is preserved across colour switches. Add to Bag adds the correct colour (Charcoal Grey - Size M) and works without size selection for resistance-band-bundle (Midnight Tones - One Size). Old handle /products/glute-sculpt-leggings-charcoal correctly 404s from API and redirects to /shop. Shop page renders 8 cards with new studio images, no broken images, no HTTP >=400 requests. SculptFlex regression passes (4 swatches, default Charcoal Grey, 4 video elements present, photo slides change per colour). Backend pytest regression suite created: 8/8 passed.

issues: Top-right 'CLOSE' label and the X icon overlap/clip each other at 1920px width - the word CLOSE is visually cut by the icon

Cards in the same row are not top-aligned: two-line titles (SculptFlex Contour Leggings) make neighbouring cards sit at different vertical offsets, giving a ragged grid. All card images are uniform 312x416 so only the text block causes it.
Radix console error: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen readers (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional polish: fix cart drawer CLOSE label/X icon overlap
Optional polish: give shop card title block a fixed min-height so rows align
Optional a11y: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden title) to Size Guide DialogContent
critical_code_review_comments: ProductGallery resets active slide to 0 on colour change (galleryKey effect). For SculptFlex this means switching colour drops the user from a photo slide back to the first video slide - consider preserving the photo index offset for a smoother UX (not a functional bug).
ProductPage.js is 406 lines with large inline data constants (SIZE_GUIDE, FEATURES, PRODUCT_FAQS, RATING_BARS); consider extracting to a constants module as the page grows.
seed_data_creation: None - sample catalog mode, no writes. Cart additions are client-side only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://sculpt-confidence-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers catalog shape + all image URLs (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py). Note SculptFlex slide 0 is a video, so [data-testid='product-main-image'] does not exist until you click product-thumb-3 or later. Checkout is mocked (url:null) - not tested.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found; only three cosmetic/a11y nits listed under design_issues.
